## The data

```{python}
#| label: load-data
raw = load_diabetes(scaled=False, as_frame=True)

diabetes = raw.frame.rename(columns={
    "bp": "blood_pressure",
    "s1": "total_cholesterol",
    "s2": "ldl",
    "s3": "hdl",
    "s4": "chol_hdl_ratio",
    "s5": "log_triglycerides",
    "s6": "blood_sugar",
    "target": "progression",
})

print(diabetes.shape)
diabetes.head()
```
